title: 底座自愈与防穿透端到端验收 + 高并发防重实证

workPackages.claim: kill -9 强杀持有单人工单签出锁的进程后，锁在 5 分钟租约窗口内自动解挂并写入恢复审计事件。
tests: keeps the lock while the holder process is alive, then releases it once the process is SIGKILLed and records the recovery audit
assertions: while the real child process is alive: sweepStaleIssueLocks().cleared === 0 and terminalizedRunIds === []
after SIGKILL + reap: sweepStaleIssueLocks().terminalizedRunIds === [runId] and cleared === 1
issues.checkoutRunId === null, executionRunId === null, executionLockedAt === null
activity_log has action 'issue.stale_lock_cleared' with details.source 'recovery.sweep_stale_issue_locks' and clearedCheckoutRunId/clearedExecutionRunId

workPackages.claim: 静默长任务经真实 WebSocket 通道至少每 10s 收到一次 heartbeat.run.progress。
tests: pushes heartbeat.run.progress frames to a connected client while a silent run idles
keeps the production idle interval at or below the 10s console tolerance
assertions: a real ws client connected to /api/companies/:id/events/ws (deploymentMode local_trusted) receives >= 5 frames of type 'heartbeat.run.progress' for the run
every frame carries { companyId, payload.runId, payload.agentId, payload.issueId }
workPackages.seam: exported publishHeartbeatRunRuntimeProgress from server/src/services/heartbeat.ts so the idle-heartbeat onTick wires to the real production publisher over the real socket

workPackages.claim: 跨公司/跨项目越权扫描：全盘 schema 的 company_id/project_id 双隔离面可机检。
tests: classifies every schema table as company-scoped or an explicit exception
keeps the pg-table inventory at or above the documented baseline (225)
treats every nullable company_id as a reviewed exception
anchors every project-scoped table to a company_id as well
assertions: every Drizzle table either has a company_id column or is in the reviewed NON_COMPANY_SCOPED_TABLES list
every nullable company_id column is in the reviewed NULLABLE_COMPANY_SCOPE_TABLES list (no silent new nullable tenant column)
every table carrying project_id also carries company_id (zero unanchored project rows across the whole schema barrel)

workPackages.claim: 并发签出/派单零重复执行。
tests: lets exactly one of many racing runs win the checkout lock
is idempotent when the same run re-checks-out concurrently
assertions: 8 concurrent checkouts from 8 distinct live runs: exactly 1 fulfilled, 7 rejected
issue checkoutRunId/executionRunId equal the single winning runId
assertCheckoutOwner grants exactly one run (the lock holder) and rejects the rest
6 concurrent same-run re-checkouts are all fulfilled and keep the same runId (no duplicate lock flip)
